missing_evidence: Order service application error/exception detail or stack traces for the 500 responses
Order CPU, thread and connection saturation metrics to exclude resource exhaustion
candidates.statement: Order service is the sole failing tier: error_rate 0.24 and p95 520ms with 10 unhandled_request_failure 500 logs, while gateway, payment and inventory each show error_rate 0.001 and p95 74ms. The checkout trace errors at the order span with no downstream span, so failures originate inside order rather than a downstream dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order-internal 500s (code defect vs. resource) is not established; deployment record alone cannot attribute cause.

report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes the incident to the order service: elevated error rate and latency plus 500 logs, with healthy gateway, payment and inventory metrics and no downstream span in the failing trace. Downstream-latency, db-pool-exhaustion and redis-timeout candidates are unsupported (zero waiters/timeouts, healthy dependencies). The specific internal fault remains unproven, so the bounded candidate is order-side HTTP 500 failures.
